title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in E2Pdf.com e2pdf…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in E2Pdf.com e2pdf versions up to 1.32.65. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in users' browsers. The flaw can lead to partial confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts.
